title: Use after free in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate… (CVE-2026-96203)
description: A use-after-free vulnerability in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. The flaw can lead to complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 8.8.
